ITEM 1 | Sliced meat pieces, two or three chunks, brown-gray exterior with pinkish-tan interior, smooth-to-slightly-fibrous surface, moist sheen, each slice about 4 cm long and 2 cm thick, lying at upper left of plate | 110
ITEM 2 | Cubed boiled potato pieces, pale cream-yellow, soft-looking edges, slightly moist surface, irregular cubes about 1.5 cm, piled in a mound at top center beside the meat | 130
ITEM 3 | Flatbread-style piece with browned, blistered char spots on golden-tan surface, slightly glossy, roughly triangular wedge about 8 cm long and 3 cm thick, at upper right of plate | 70
ITEM 4 | Chopped romaine-type lettuce leaves, dark green outer edges fading to pale green-white ribs, glossy coated sheen with creamy white dressing clinging to leaves, crisp-looking pieces about 4 to 6 cm, lower left of plate | 90
ITEM 5 | Creamy white dressing, thick and clinging, coating lettuce leaves and pooling slightly in folds, matte-to-glossy, lower left among the greens | 25
ITEM 6 | Grilled zucchini and yellow squash pieces, golden-yellow with green skin edges, lightly charred or browned spots, chunky wedges about 3 cm, slightly soft and moist, lower right of plate beside the flatbread | 85
